A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Asparagus**: Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and paprika. Sear skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet (5 min). Flip, add asparagus, garlic, lemon slices, and butter. Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 15–20 min until chicken hits 165°F. Finish with fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread or quick-cook rice.
